import arrow
from arrow.locales import get_locale

def test_maltese_locale():

    assert locale.month_names[1] == "Jannar"
    assert locale.day_names[7] == "Ħaddut"

def test_malay_locale_fix():

    assert locale.day_abbreviations[7] == "Ahad"
